column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row <sub>/requests/<rid>. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the holder — stops the operation over this row without a write, a deletion or a call of the action, a log line and `garbled_rows` of the heartbeat + 1 (chapter 3.6 «holder's look», chapter 3.4 N1.1); a row without unit — not an ordinary request (the holder does not consider it, chapter 3.6 «holder's look»); the filer (worker.requests of another manifest), meeting at filing a row that exists but is unreadable, — does not file again and does not touch the row, a log line without the value, `filings.<outcome>` without `filed` (chapter 3.6 N1.5)
column6: P/03.6 N3 «holder's look», N4; P/03.4 N1.1 garbled_rows; P/03.6 N1.5 submit

column3: the whole row is unreadable: the reaper — there is no ground for removal, does not mark and does not remove the row («An unknown read does not allow row deletion», N3 «States of an executed request and its mark»); the request door at step 4 (the row already exists) — 409 `exists`, as for another unit/digest: the identity is not confirmed; do not touch the row, do not roll back the reservation
column6: P/06.4 N1.5, N3 «States of an executed request and its mark», «file a request» step 4, N4
